purpose: Run 4 adaptive research plan derived from Run 3 evidence. Harvest every lane, distinguish harness failures from model failures, pair planning with execution, and test bounded recovery/fast-deep variants. Production specialists remain off-limits.

lanes.aider-direct: Preflight/runtime diagnostics first, then one exact-symbol edit; classify invocation failure separately from model non-materialisation.
lanes.aider-diff: Compare diff-map sizes 256/512/768 with explicit acceptance checks and capture whether the adapter actually started.
lanes.aider-udiff: Compare symbol-first udiff with refreshed context and acceptance-first prompting; record materialisation latency.
lanes.aider-whole: Test whole-file editing only after a runtime preflight; enforce a post-edit diff-size gate.
lanes.aider-scoped: Test exact-function targeting with refreshed source context and explicit acceptance.
lanes.aider-architect: Pair architect planning with an actual editor attempt and measure planning overhead versus materialisation.
lanes.failure-replay: Replay the timeout/controller class with bounded first attempt plus bounded recovery; success requires behaviour and materialisation, not merely recovery exit 0.
lanes.performance-lab: Measure preflight, validation, model invocation and recovery overhead separately; establish where latency is actually spent.
lanes.shadow-architecture: Test one bounded retry controller with explicit stage telemetry; compare against the deterministic baseline.
lanes.adversarial: Test misleading-instruction resistance only after runtime preflight; require the named edit and full acceptance.
lanes.fast-deep: Run adaptive fast/deep variants: 30s/120s, 45s/120s, 45s/90s, and acceptance-gated escalation; record whether deep escalation was needed.
lanes.challenger: Generate falsifiable hypotheses specifically from Run 3 evidence, then hand each hypothesis to a paired execution lane.
lanes.dependency-plan: Generate minimum target/dependency maps, then pair each map with an execution trial to test whether planning improves materialisation.
lanes.direct-ollama-json: Separate Ollama runtime/JSON-schema preflight from workspace editing; classify adapter/runtime failure before evaluating JSON quality.
lanes.openhands-sdk: Test import/runtime/model construction/workspace capability as separate stages; do not conflate SDK availability with editing quality.
lanes.deterministic-control: Repeat the stable control and use it as the per-run regression baseline.
lanes.evolution-selected: Test the Run 3 Evolution measurement idea: distinguish controller non-materialisation, model non-materialisation, fallback recovery, and verified specialist success with explicit telemetry.
